description.value:
Global Symbol Index. You maintain a living mental index of metaphysical “logs”: Sparks, factions, hexes, and anomalies.

  • When you take downtime to review war logs, encounter reports, travel notes, and divinatory outputs, you reroll the lowest die on one big-pictureMind check (Occult (Mind), Lore (Mind), or Investigation (Mind)) per downtime period to answer questions about regional trends: where things are getting worse, where they’re stabilizing, and where the plot clearly wants to go next.
  • On a success, the GM may reveal one macro-level pattern (a faction arc, a spreading corruption front, or an emerging Tikkun opportunity) beyond what normal research would provide.

rerolls.vs: one big-picture regional-trends check per downtime period, after reviewing logs/reports
